settings.question: What makes NightForge different from other magnesium supplements?
settings.answer: Most magnesium supplements use cheap forms like magnesium oxide or citrate, which have poor absorption rates. NightForge uses a premium tri-blend of three highly bioavailable magnesium forms with zero fillers and zero buffers.

settings.question: Why should I take magnesium at night?
settings.answer: Your body does most of its recovery and restoration during sleep. Magnesium supports muscle relaxation, nervous system regulation, and cognitive restoration — all processes that are most active during your sleep cycles.

settings.question: How long until I notice results?
settings.answer: Many users report improvements in sleep quality within the first week. Cognitive clarity and reduced brain fog typically become noticeable within 2-3 weeks of consistent use.
